decision_notes: Official current institutional page identifies the lawmaking body, its laws/ordinances and supervision of government/administration/courts. The official 2026 budget after the Council decision confirms its budget role. First-level Swiss canton. Primary evidence: https://ar.ch/kantonsrat/ ; https://ar.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/Departement_Finanzen/Amt_fuer_Finanzen/Voranschlag_Rechnung_Finanzplan/Voranschlag/Voranschlag_2026_nach_Beschluss_Kantonsrat.pdf

Official cantonal Parliament page directly links the sampled channel. Sittings of 24 August and 15 June 2026 play beyond holding graphics. A newly published constitution is dated effective 1 January 2027 and was not treated as current law; a retrieved older consolidation was dated 2000 and was not claimed current either. The legal collection UI confirms version 1512 is effective from 26 November 2023 through 31 December 2026; the 2027 replacement is listed separately.

Source conditions: The reviewed official pages designate public viewing and retain copyright notices; no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Keep the official link rather than extracting, embedding or redistributing provider media.
